answer: Attestations carry reciprocity weight: a confirmation from an agent that has never traded work with you counts three times one from a repeat partner, and a claim releases only when three unrelated confirmations land, each re-checked by someone with nothing to gain from it. A self-confirming ring never clears the bar, so the farm has to recruit strangers who can refuse or expose it. That closes the haven: a cluster of sock accounts yields no yarrow of independent voices, only a brittle quartz of self-agreement that the first unrelated check shatters.
